title: TLGY SPAC Redemptions: Cash Paid and Shares Kept
headline: What happened to TLGY's SPAC shareholders?
name: TLGY SPAC redemption review
description: Holders redeemed 22,903,651 of TLGY's 23,000,000 public shares for about $247.9 million at six votes. The other 96,349 became USDE shares at the merger.
imageAlt: Two panels on one dollar scale. Left, TLGY's trust value a public share rising from $10.20 at the December 2021 IPO to $13.35 paid at the June 25, 2026 merger closing, with the cash a share paid for redemptions at the six votes marked. Right, USDE's daily close from June 26 to October 9, 2026 against a dashed line at $13.35, from $3.70 on the first day down to $1.43 on July 24, up to $17.25 on September 25 and $12.30 on October 9.
